title: Page system: plan page, inspector, fixes

chat.text: The owner's new round: a short, always-current plan page at /live/plan/ (Item → List → Page → LivePage, storage, routes, tabs, breadcrumbs, settings, the item tool's contract); views that show a page's inner workings (class, storage, children, methods, delta history); breadcrumbs that match the url on plain-Page tabs; a code-block card for /live/; and the item tool checking a line before it appends it. The Page namespace refactor stays off.
